route_note: Take a shared taxi or minibus from Baku's Central Bus Station toward Gobustan, about an hour, then a local taxi from the village to the reserve, since the petroglyphs and mud volcanoes are spread out and not walkable from the main road.
see: Gobustan State Historical-Artistic Reserve rock carvings

route_note: There is no train; take a shared taxi or minibus from Baku's Central Bus Station to Shamakhi, roughly two hours, and walk or take a short taxi ride to the old town and Juma Mosque.
see: Old town streets and historic houses
